scope: Secondary robustness diagnostic registered after pilot observation but before formal-holdout model generation; primary frozen metric unchanged.
motivation: The primary joint metric checks a complete annotated rationale subset and can accept extraneous source-bound citations.
annotation_supported_only_joint: Require primary joint correctness plus every predicted document/sentence reference belonging to the union of benchmark rationale sentences bearing the correct label. NEI keeps the same empty-evidence rule.
precision_diagnostic: For correctly labeled decisive claims with valid source binding, compute predicted-reference precision against the union of correctly labeled annotated rationale sentences; report conditional sample count and mean, not as a substitute for complete denominators.
arms: All raw candidates, canonical clean references and final selected responses.
denominator: 75 claims for the secondary joint endpoint; no deletion of malformed, wrong-label, withheld or truncated cases.
limitations: Annotations may not exhaust every semantically relevant sentence. This is annotation-relative citation specificity, not an independently adjudicated entailment guarantee.
